messages.subject: upgrading Boost and Eigen
parts:
Boost's up to 1.55 and Eigen's still at 3.2.0.

Do we want to update Boost? I know there was some
discussion by Ben of not being so agressive in
updating versions because of R and Linux compatibility
issues.

- Bob

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] upgrading Boost and Eigen
parts:
In the case of Boost, unless there are specific features we want or bugs we need fixed, I'd say it's fine to lag a bit behind.  I don't think it's worth the time chasing Boost versions.  (I realize it's likely not tons of time, but it's non-zero: it still it takes developer time and testing time that is almost certainly better spent elsewhere.)

For Eigen keeping up to date is likely to help with performance so I think it's important to keep up with that one.
